summary: The segmenter is overly conservative: most long, multi-clause utterances with clear connectives (는데, 그런데, 그래서, 거나, 했더니) are left completely unsplit, causing systemic under-segmentation and lost latency gain. Where splits do occur, boundaries sometimes cut subordinate or causal clauses that need prior-clause context, breaking pronoun/subject resolution or verb-scope meaning. One case also shows a shared entity mistranslation (유성) present in both reference and hypothesis, indicating a reference quality issue rather than segmentation.
